14164.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

down.description: To the down lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14164.description:
This is the corner where the outer walls meet at a great bastion, its
top a broad platform of cracked stone. A hole torn in the middle of the
platform opens onto a dark stair that leads down into the hall along the
inner wall. Iron rings for siege engines are sunk in the flagstones,
rusted fast. The walkway runs east along one wall and south along the
other.

14165.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14165.description:
The wall top is strewn with rubble here, chunks of masonry and broken
coping stones fallen from a tower that has since collapsed. You pick a
careful path between them, the wind tugging at you each time you step
close to the edge. East the walk narrows between strangely smooth walls,
and west it opens toward a broad corner bastion.

22150.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22150.description:
A smooth-walled passage runs here where the open walkway should be, and
its stone is warm, as if polished by long friction. The instant you are
between the walls they begin to grind together, slow and certain. Dust
pours from the seams overhead, and dark stains streak the stone at about
the height of a man's chest. The roar of moving rock swallows every
other sound.

14167.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14167.description:
A flagstaff leans from the parapet at a drunken angle, the iron collar
that held it cracked in two and its pole charred from top to bottom.
Ashes of a banner cling in the joints of the stones, and a scorched
crest is still just visible carved on the wall beneath. Past the
parapet, rust-red cliffs and dead plains fall away into haze. The walk
goes east and west, though westward it closes between smooth walls.

14168.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14168.description:
The walkway is cracked into slabs here, each tilting a different way, so
that you step from one to the next like stones in a stream. Between them
the gaps show the hollow wall beneath, a dark shaft full of wind. Iron
fittings bolted to the parapet weep long streaks of rust down the stone.
The walk runs west, and east it narrows into a colder, stiller passage.

22023.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle
22023.description:
The passage narrows and the chill deepens. Rust flakes from iron
fittings, drifting like black snow. A heavy stillness settles here,
pressing against the skin.

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14170.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14170.description:
A trough of stone runs along the inner side of the walkway here, meant
once to carry boiling oil to the murder holes; it is cracked and stained
black. The murder holes themselves gape in the parapet, square and
empty, looking down on the castle gate far beneath. Wind pours through
them with a low, hollow note. The wall top leads east and west, westward
into a chill and narrowing passage.

14171.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14171.description:
An entire section of battlements has been sheared away here, and for
several paces the walkway runs with no parapet at all, open on the outer
side to the long drop. The wind comes straight across the gap and
threatens to shove you off. West the walk runs back toward the oil
troughs, and east it enters a passage between smooth stone walls that
look newer than everything around them.

22151.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle
22151.description: You stumble into a deadly crushing walls! There is no escape...

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14173.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14173.description:
This stretch is littered with the shards of a shattered statue, a stone
warrior whose plinth still stands on the parapet with only a pair of
booted feet left upon it. The wind has scoured the broken pieces smooth
and pale. East the walkway leads to a turret at the corner of the wall,
while west it disappears between close, smooth walls of dressed stone.

extra_descs.plinth statue feet:
Only the statue's booted feet remain on the plinth, broken off at the
ankle. Letters were once cut into the plinth's face, but they have been
chiselled out deliberately, leaving a rough scar.

14174.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

down.description: To the down lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14174.description:
The walkway turns a corner here, where two lengths of the outer wall
meet in a squat, roofless turret. A square hole in the turret floor
drops down a ladder of iron rungs toward the hall along the inner wall.
The wind comes over the battlements in hard, cold gusts, snatching at
cloaks and breath alike. The broken walk runs on south along the wall
top and west along the other face.

14175.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14175.description:
Here a whole merlon has toppled inward and lies split across the
walkway, so that you must clamber over its broken halves. Where it
stood, nothing but a gap of empty air guards the drop to the scorched
plain far below. Grit and flakes of mortar skitter along the stones with
every gust. The walk goes on north toward the corner turret and south
along the wall.

14176.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14176.description:
A rusted iron brazier stands bolted to the parapet, its bowl full of old
rainwater and a crust of black ash. The flagstones around it are
scorched in a wide ring, as though the fire once spilled over. Beyond
the battlements the dead land rolls away, grey and cracked, without a
single tree. The walkway stretches north and south, its edges crumbling.

14177.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14177.description:
A dark stain spreads across the flagstones here and runs down between
the cracks, old enough to have dried brown, fresh enough to still smell
of iron. Scrape marks lead to a gap in the parapet, as if something
heavy was dragged to the edge and tipped over. The wind moans through
that gap like a voice. The walkway continues north and south.

14178.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14178.description:
The walkway grows narrower, hemmed in by iron stakes driven into the
stone along both edges, their points flaking rust. A stone gargoyle
crouches on the parapet, its face worn half away by wind and rain, its
open mouth staring out over the wasteland. Ahead to the south the stakes
crowd thicker, closing into a passage of spikes. The way back runs north
along the open wall.

extra_descs.gargoyle stone:
The gargoyle has the body of a hunched hound and the wings of a bat, but
wind and rain have worn its face to a blunt, eyeless knob. Its jaws
still gape wide, and rust from the iron pin that holds it has stained
its chest red.

22102.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle
22102.description:
The path narrows into a cramped passage of spikes and iron. Shadows
cling to the walls, flickering with no light. The floor is slick with
dark residue.

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14180.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14180.description:
Past the passage of spikes the walk opens a little, though the parapet
here is little more than a stump of broken stone, knee-high and leaning
outward. A banner pole juts from a socket in the wall, burned to a
charred stick, a few blackened rags still knotted at its top. The wind
tears at them without mercy. The walkway leads north back toward the
spikes and south into deepening shadow.

22024.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22024.description:
Darkness lies thick on this stretch of the wall, as if the stones
themselves drink the light. You feel your way along the parapet with one
hand, the stone cold and gritty, and more than once your fingers find
nothing where a merlon should be. The wind howls unseen, and somewhere
far below loose stones rattle as they fall. The walk gropes on north and
south.

14182.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

down.description: To the down lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14182.description:
The walkway meets a bend in the wall here, and a stair of worn steps
spirals down through a broken hatch into the castle below. Iron hinges
hang from the hatch frame, rusted through, the door itself long gone.
The walk runs north along the wall, and west a narrow stretch disappears
between high, close-set walls of dressed stone that look oddly smooth
and new. Wind whistles down the stairwell like a breath drawn in.

22156.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22156.description:
Close walls of dressed stone rise on either hand, and the moment you
step between them a deep grinding begins somewhere inside the masonry.
The walls are moving, sliding together on hidden runners with a sound
like a millstone. Dust sifts from above as the gap shrinks to an arm's
width, then less. There is no ledge to climb, no door, and no time left.

22180.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22180.description:
Here the passage is barely wider than your shoulders, the stones on both
sides scored with long scratches where someone tried to hold them apart.
A low rumble shakes the floor, and the walls lurch inward a hand's
breadth at a time. Old bones lie crushed flat in the cracks between the
flagstones. Whatever way you turn, the stone is closing.

22162.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22162.description:
Bloody handprints streak the smooth walls of this passage, smeared
downward as if someone slid to the floor between them. With a shudder
and a groan of chains deep in the castle, the two walls begin to grind
toward each other. Splinters of old shields are pressed into the mortar
where they failed to hold the stone back. The darkness fills with the
roar of moving rock.

22030.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22030.description:
A cold draught comes up through cracks in the walkway here, and in the
dark you can hear the wind boring through the hollow wall beneath your
feet. The parapet on one side has fallen entirely, leaving a lip of
broken stone over a sheer drop. Somewhere ahead the grinding of great
stones murmurs through the masonry. The walk leads east and west into
blackness.

22031.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22031.description:
Your boots crunch on a carpet of fallen slates, shed from some tower
roof that once stood over this stretch and is now only a jagged stump.
In the gloom the stump looms like a broken tooth against the faint glow
of the wasteland's horizon. Rusted iron cramps that once bound the
stones together jut from the wreckage at odd angles. The walkway runs on
east and west.

22034.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22034.description:
The walk sags here, the stones beneath it bowed by some old collapse
inside the wall, so that every step tilts you toward the edge. A chain
hangs from a bracket on the parapet and swings in the dark, its links
clinking against the stone. Faintly, through the soles of your feet, you
feel a rhythm of grinding from the way to the west. East the sagging
walk climbs back toward firmer stone.

22163.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22163.description:
The walkway funnels into a sealed passage of smooth stone, and a heavy
slab drops behind you with a boom that shakes your teeth. At once the
side walls shudder and begin to close, pushed by some engine buried deep
in the castle. The air fills with stone dust and the shriek of grinding
rock. There is nowhere left to stand.

14190.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14190.description:
Pale grey daylight returns to the wall here, falling on a stretch of
battlement scarred by fire. Every merlon is blackened, and an iron fire-
basket hangs crooked from a hook, rusted into a shapeless lump. Both
ways the walk vanishes between smooth, close walls: east into a passage
that rumbles faintly, west into a hall where something heavy swings and
whistles. Out past the parapet, the dead land stretches to a ruddy,
smoking horizon.

22157.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle
22157.description: You stumble into a deadly pendulum hall! There is no escape...

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14192.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

east.description: To the east lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

down.description: To the down lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14192.description:
A corner of the outer wall, where a squat tower once rose and now stands
only shoulder-high. Inside its broken ring a stair winds down into the
castle, the steps choked with rubble. North the walkway runs on along
the wall top, and east a narrow passage echoes with a slow, heavy swish
of iron. The wind spins ash and grit around the ruined tower in tight
circles.

22103.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22103.description:
Shadow pools over this length of the walk, cast by a tall fragment of
wall that leans out above it like a hand about to close. Beneath it the
light is so poor that the edge of the walkway is only a guess. Water
drips from the overhang and gathers in hollows worn into the flagstones.
The walk goes north and south beneath the leaning stone.

14194.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14194.description:
The parapet here is crowned with iron spikes set in lead, most of them
snapped or bent outward by some long-ago assault. The broken hooks of a
siege ladder are still caught on the stones, the wood long rotted away.
To the north the walk narrows between smooth, close walls, and to the
south it falls into deep shadow. The wind is so strong here that you
lean into it just to stand.

22152.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

22152.description:
You step between two walls of polished stone that should not be here at
all, and the floor drops a finger's breadth beneath your weight with a
click. Deep in the castle something answers, and both walls begin to
slide inward with a terrible grinding patience. Crushed armour and old
bones are pressed flat into the joints. The passage shrinks around you.

14196.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14196.description:
A wide breach yawns in the outer face of the wall, where a whole section
of parapet has slumped away into the ditch far beneath. Only a ledge of
cracked flagstones, scarcely two paces wide, carries the walk past it.
Looking down makes your head swim: the drop goes on and on to a ruin of
rubble at the wall's foot. The walkway carries on north, while south it
slips between close, smooth walls.

14197.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14197.description:
An old guard post stands here, a stone booth with no roof, its doorway
facing into the wind. Inside, a bench is carved from the wall itself and
a rusted lamp hook hangs empty. Names and tally marks are scratched
across the inner stone, years of bored sentries keeping count of
something. The walkway runs north and south past the booth.

extra_descs.names tally marks scratches:
Dozens of names are scratched into the stone, most of them worn faint,
each followed by rows of tally marks in groups of five. The newest marks
stop halfway through a group.

14198.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14198.description:
Two gargoyles flank the walk here, perched on the parapet back to back,
one gazing out over the wasteland and one into the castle's inner
courts. Rainwater has worn grooves down their stone flanks, and one has
lost its head entirely. Between them the walkway is cracked straight
across, a hand-wide fissure that whistles when the wind blows. North and
south the wall top goes on.

14199.name: Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14199.description:
The walk climbs here over a hump in the wall where the masonry has
heaved up, and the flagstones tilt like the deck of a ship in a swell.
From the crest you can see the whole broken length of the outer wall
curving away, its towers gutted and its battlements gap-toothed. Wind
screams over the crest and drives grit into your eyes. The walkway goes
north toward a corner and south down the slope.
